parameters.name: api_filter

schema.description: Filter to control which routes are returned. Can be an API level ('v1', 'v1alpha', 'v1beta') to show non-deprecated routes at that level, or 'deprecated' to show deprecated routes across all levels. If not specified, returns all non-deprecated routes.
